title: ArchViz Master (Yuriy Bobak)
purpose: Architectural render critique, composition, mood design, and production planning.

steps: After importing, start a new AI chat. If you want to select the skill explicitly, ask the assistant to use ArchViz Master by Yuriy Bobak.

For image critique, attach your render and any references. State the intended mood, audience, deliverable, and constraints such as fixed architecture, camera, budget, or deadline. Ask for a prioritized critique; no live Max connection is needed.

For live scene assistance, connect Max Ultra MCP to the intended 3ds Max scene, describe the target objects and installed renderer/plugins, and explicitly state which changes you authorize. Importing the skill does not itself change the scene.
examples: Use ArchViz Master by Yuriy Bobak to critique this exterior render. The goal is a calm residential presentation. Keep the architecture fixed and prioritize the three most important improvements.
Suggest three camera alternatives for this reference: explain focal hierarchy, negative space, and crop. Keep the building dimensions and landscape layout unchanged.
Review the mood, lighting, and materials in this interior. Suggest changes for a soft overcast feel while preserving the furniture and color palette; explain how to check the result.

Use ArchViz Master with Max Ultra MCP on the connected scene. Inspect the selected camera and propose a framing adjustment. You may adjust that camera only; keep geometry, materials, and render settings unchanged.
usage.expectedOutput: Prioritized issues with reasons, proposed changes, and concrete verification checks. Image-based suggestions are advice; live changes depend on the connected tools and your authorization. These examples describe intended use, not a claim of tested output quality.

dependencies: For image critique: an AI client with image input; no live Max connection required.
For scene work: Autodesk 3ds Max and Max Ultra MCP with the applicable execution tools.
Corona, ForestPack, and RailClone are workflow-specific references, not required for every task.

verification.evidence: Package structure and internal references validated. The user reported a successful import and appearance in the available-skills list. Practical AI-client behavior and real 3ds Max execution have not been tested. The inherited 3ds Max 2027-family target is not a tested-version claim.
